setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (5 reviews, 1 other source): Listed as having Peter Green sitting in on the closing Lovelight; Reviewer calls the Lovelight a trip, with classic Pigpen vocals [1][6][7][9][10][11]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): Band opens by arguing over how many beats to count in, settling on 18 [12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer calls the China Cat into Rider strong [13]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Highlight is The Other One into Lovelight; a tape cut drops the first verse and the segue skips a verse [12]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-01.126275.sbd.lee-smith.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 16 songs; 139 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd70-02-01.sbd.kaplan.9629.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 16 songs; 136 min; rated 4.1/5 by 10 [2]. Said about its sound: Weir is too loud for the first few songs; after Bear's solo the mix becomes quite good; Weir is high in the mix, but everything is still decently audible [12][13]
- **gd70-02-01.psbd.cousinit.18121.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 2 songs; 44 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Show was a benefit for a bust fund, after New Orleans police arrested the band on 31 January 1970 [1]
- Fan Marty Kasdan recalls it was the venue's opening weekend; The Flock opened the first two nights, followed by Fleetwood Mac, then the Dead [1]
- Show was a benefit for the bust the previous day [4]
- Police surrounded the Warehouse on all three nights, per a Blair Jackson account the reviewer quotes [6]
- The Dead, Fleetwood Mac and The Flock gave their income from one show to the bust fund [6]
- Mick Fleetwood reportedly wore an 'out of order' sign around his neck [7]
- Reviewer thinks this Lovelight may be the longest song the band ever played [9]
- Reviewer says the longest Lovelight is instead 6/6/69 at Fillmore West [11]
- Good listen but not the year's best show; apart from Lovelight, no epic jams [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-01.126275.sbd.lee-smith.flac16**: transferred by Matt Smith and Pat Lee; source: Lineage: Source 1 SBD > MSR > C > DAT (Biodtl thru O1(7:27); Source 2 MR > Revox A77 > tube pre (O1@7:27 thru Lovelight); Transfer info: Bottlehead tube tape… [1]
- **gd70-02-01.sbd.kaplan.9629.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard (Full Show) [2]
- **gd70-02-01.psbd.cousinit.18121.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Cousinit; source: Soundboard (Partial Show) [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Mason's Children: [February Grateful Dead Show Listening Guides](https://www.gratefuldeadbook.com/post/february-grateful-dead-show-listening-guides) [17]
